+# Release Notes for JavaFX 27.0.1.1
+
+## Introduction
+
+The following notes describe important changes and information about this release. In some cases, the descriptions provide links to additional detailed information about an issue or a change.
+
+These notes document the JavaFX 27.0.1.1 update release. As such, they complement the [JavaFX 27](https://github.com/openjdk/jfx27u/blob/master/doc-files/release-notes-27.md) and [JavaFX 27.0.1](https://github.com/openjdk/jfx27u/blob/master/doc-files/release-notes-27.0.1.md) release notes.
+
